explanation: Combine two zero-based source draws into a uniform state in 0..24. Accept states below 21 and map each group of seven uniformly into 1..7.
correctness: Each pair is one of 25 equally likely states. Accepting 21 states leaves three representatives for each remainder modulo seven, so each result has conditional probability 1/7.
walkthrough: For injected draws 5,5,1,1, the first pair creates state (5-1)*5+(5-1)=24, which is rejected. The next pair creates state 0 and returns 1. Among accepted states 0..20, each remainder modulo seven occurs three times, giving probability 1/7 for each output. The displayed true reports the judge properties. Rand7 has no value arguments and returns one integer 1..7. JSON contains a judge-only forced Rand5 draw prefix; expected true denotes random-source/range/distribution checks, not the rolled integer.
edgeCases: no modulo bias from all 25 states.
States 21..24 must be rejected; taking all 25 states modulo seven would favor four outcomes. Repeated rejections must not cache a previous roll.
timeComplexity: Expected O(1) time: an attempt succeeds with probability 21/25 and uses two source calls, for 50/21 expected calls. Worst-case attempts are unbounded.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space: two draws and one encoded state, reused on every retry.
